slot_note: Root-Cause Analysis number seeded RC04 (commuter rail delay causes); the rail world has no Root-Cause task type in the client taxonomy (supply-chain-logistics maps to urban-regional-science, which serves no RC, and general-statistics interpretability was ruled a backdrop for an operations world at task129 v1), so the build moved to quantitative finance under the same objective and number, keeping the decision shape (which one of five causes gets the one fix, priced as the shortfall it would have removed, with the runner-up).
niche: a UK authorised fund's managed-risk equity fund: which one of five changes its authorised fund manager's board makes for 2026-27, each priced as the 2025-26 shortfall against the benchmark it would have removed, after a drawdown rule moved the fund to its defensive allocation in March and the rebound went by
answer: run the value sleeve as a tracker of the benchmark: 830 bp of the 970 bp shortfall removed; runner-up the higher trigger (12 per cent), 520 bp; gap 310 bp
answer_source: generator/figures.json (bp_A, bp_C, gap_bp, short_bp), recomputed from target/ by generator/verify.py; shipped target.zip 4d9a7a57
analyst_test: A strong analyst who conforms every holdings, price and overlay file and reads the prospectus correctly attributes the year's shortfall by sleeve, overlay and cash, books the April-to-June rebound the defensive allocation missed to the drawdown overlay, prices each change on those effects (or replays each change holding the recorded futures), and files raising the trigger to 12 per cent (547 linked, 519 held, against 306 and 313 for the value tracker), when the replay with the overlay rule run on each changed fund's own price shows that running the value sleeve as a tracker removes 830 bp against 520.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is the shortfall against the benchmark each change would have removed, which performance analysis prices by return attribution and, for a fund whose exposure a filed rule sets from the fund's own price path, by replaying the year with that rule run on the changed fund; with hospital or utility nouns the sentence loses its object, because only a portfolio carries an exposure that its own price sets and a benchmark it is measured against.
layer1: a depositary and custody change on 1 April 2026: the old custodian's holdings keyed by SEDOL with prices in pence, the new one's keyed by ISIN with prices in pounds
both custodians report settled holdings and settlement-dated statements; trades in flight at the change settled late after Easter
accumulation and income share classes, the income class's price dropping at each ex-distribution date
the overlay manager's futures blotter stamped in UTC across the March clock change
the fund's noon valuation point against the index's close, a price index beside the total return
the bank's suspension and resolution: no price after suspension, a nil value at once, the custodian's last price until cancellation
sub-adviser reports as a workbook with a header block and as a PDF table, close to close against their style indices
stakeholder_role: the authorised fund manager's investment oversight analyst preparing the board's annual review

world.org_type: an authorised fund manager running a UK open-ended fund with two external sub-advisers and a futures overlay manager

driver: The decisive quantity is what removing one component's loss does to a whole whose exposure a filed rule sets from the whole's own path: the loss carried the path across the rule's line, so the rule's cut and the recovery it missed belong to that component's counterfactual, while an attribution that holds the recorded exposure books them to the rule.
driver_concrete: Indexing the value sleeve removes not only Penrose Bank's collapse but the move to the 40 per cent defensive allocation that the collapse made the drawdown rule order on 20 March, because without the Penrose position the fund's drawdown stays inside the 8 per cent line, so the year replayed with the rule run on the changed fund's own price credits the value sleeve with the rebound the defensive allocation missed.
stump: A competent solver attributes the 2025-26 shortfall by sleeve, overlay and cash, books the April-to-June rebound the defensive allocation missed to the drawdown overlay, and files raising the trigger to 12 per cent (520 bp against 310 for the value tracker); the step that lands it there is holding the recorded exposure fixed in each change's counterfactual, when the overlay sets the exposure from the fund's own price and Penrose Bank's collapse is what carried the drawdown past 8 per cent.
notes: Spent screens for this number's draw are in the design note's Tried and rejected. Asks: dividend income by sleeve and quarter (elective events absent from the old custodian's report; a due dividend never paid), dealing costs by quarter of trade (settlement-dated statements across the New Year holiday), AIM holdings at quarter-ends (listing transfers to the Main Market).
